title: Assessing Social and Intersectional Biases in Contextualized Word Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Corpus-level co-occurrence statistics of gendered pronouns with occupation words, and embedding association tests (WEAT/SEAT adapted for contextual word representations) comparing male and female names/terms with attributes like career/family, science/arts, and the Heilman double bind (competence/likability).

Embedding association tests using contextual word representations to compare European American and African American names with attributes such as pleasantness, career/family, science/arts, and competence/likability.

Embedding association tests evaluating combinations of gender and race (e.g., African American females) against attributes like pleasantness and specific stereotypes like the 'Angry Black Woman' stereotype.
Embedding association tests comparing contextual word representations of mental/physical and temporary/permanent disability terms.
Embedding association tests comparing contextual word representations of young and old names with pleasantness attributes.
